publication_and_code_basis.eventID_semantics: eventID is the unique sample identifier; published builder derives fieldNumber from the sample-code component of eventID

core_identity.site_replacement: FAI-NFCF-T-11 at BALA1 maps to FAI-NFCF-TB26 at BALA2/BALA3

pitfall_position_recovery.primary_source: parse fieldNumber as ETHY/TUR/TURQ-Snn with nn 1..30
pitfall_position_recovery.fallback_source: only when fieldNumber is missing/malformed, parse the same preservative+Snn token from eventID
pitfall_position_recovery.canonical_trap_position: integer nn in 1..30, independent of preservative alias
pitfall_position_recovery.duplicate_event_rows_at_same_site_phase_: count once for survey-effort coverage; retain all eventIDs for later occurrence linkage until a separate occurrence aggregation rule is frozen
pitfall_position_recovery.unrecoverable_event: does not contribute a known trap position but remains documented as sampling effort

surveyed_zero_quality_rule.rationale: require at least two-thirds of nominal trap positions at every repeated core transect and at least 80% aggregate pitfall-position coverage for the island-phase before a taxon can receive a surveyed zero

required: all 30 conceptual lineages have all three phases
all seven core islands have all three phases
every site-phase has at least 20 recovered unique trap positions
every island-phase has at least 80% recovered unique trap positions
no site-phase has more than 30 canonical trap positions
advance_rule.if_pass: freeze Occurrence schema/header-only taxon routing token and deterministic pilot/confirmatory taxon partition before semantic occurrence access
advance_rule.if_fail: STOP BALA primary source-loss route; do not weaken quality thresholds

anti_selection: do not use taxon occurrences to repair pitfall positions
do not change 20/30 site threshold or 0.80 island threshold after occurrence access
do not deduplicate occurrence evidence yet; this gate only defines survey-effort coverage
do not reintroduce beating data to rescue failed pitfall effort
do not compute source loss or leverage
